meta.title: LIC Term Insurance (2025) — Plans, Premiums, Comparisons & How to Buy
meta.description: Complete 2025 guide to LIC term insurance — Tech-Term, Jeevan Amar & Jeevan Kiran. Premium examples, buy online steps, claim process & FAQs.

byline:
By Mahesh Chaube, CFP — Last reviewed: January 2025
Reviewed by Laveena Vijayi — BharatSaver Editorial Team

sections.title: Quick take: best LIC term plan for you

content.text: For most buyers who want low cost + trust, LIC New Tech-Term is the best overall choice (lowest online premium). If you want agent help, consider Jeevan Amar. Avoid Return-of-Premium plans unless you prefer guaranteed return over cost efficiency.

sections.title: Which LIC term plans exist (short product list + UINs)

content.text:
LIC's New Tech-Term (Plan No. 954, UIN: 512N339V02)

This is LIC’s flagship online-only term plan. Because it's sold directly without agent commissions, it offers the most competitive premium from LIC. Official LIC Page

  • Key Feature: Lowest premium due to online purchase rebate.
  • Eligibility: Entry age 18-65, policy term 10-40 years.
  • Best Use Case: For self-directed individuals comfortable with purchasing and managing their policy online to get the best price.

LIC's New Jeevan Amar (Plan No. 955, UIN: 512N338V02)

This is the offline version of Tech-Term. It has nearly identical features but is sold through agents and other intermediaries. The premium is slightly higher to account for agent commissions. Official LIC Page

  • Key Feature: Can be purchased offline with agent assistance.
  • Eligibility: Entry age 18-65, policy term 10-40 years.
  • Best Use Case: For those who prefer face-to-face guidance and assistance with the application process and future servicing.

LIC's Jeevan Kiran (Plan No. 870, UIN: 512N359V02)

This is LIC's 'Return of Premium' (ROP) plan. You pay a higher premium, but if you survive the policy term, LIC returns all the premiums you've paid (excluding taxes and rider charges). Official LIC Page

  • Key Feature: Return of all premiums on survival.
  • Eligibility: Entry age 18-65, policy term 10-40 years.
  • Best Use Case: For individuals who find it psychologically difficult to pay for a 'pure risk' product and want some tangible return. Financially, it is often better to buy a cheaper pure term plan and invest the difference.

sections.title: How LIC term premiums are calculated (age, smoker, sum assured, PPT)

content.text: Premiums reflect actuarial risk: younger age = lower premium, smokers pay materially more, higher sum assured costs more, and longer terms increase cost. Use the calculator above for exact quotes tailored to age, gender, smoker status and PPT.

We used live premium examples from market aggregators (PolicyBazaar, PolicyX) for common scenarios (₹50L/₹1Cr, ages 25/30/35; smoker/non-smoker). Use the calculator above to get an exact quote for your profile — premiums differ widely by age and product.

sections.title: LIC vs Private insurers — premium & feature comparison (table)

content.text: LIC combines a nationwide service network and a long history of paying claims, making it the natural choice for buyers who value offline support and brand trust. Recent online plans (Tech-Term, Digi Term) now offer competitive pricing for self-service buyers.

rows: Often more innovative features and wider rider choices

sections.title: Riders & add-ons you should consider (and those to avoid)

content.text:
Worthwhile Add-ons:
  • Accidental Death & Disability Benefit Rider: A must-have. Provides an extra payout in case of an accident.
  • Critical Illness Rider: Provides a lump sum on diagnosis of major illnesses like cancer or heart attack. A good alternative to a separate health insurance top-up.
What to Avoid:
  • Return of Premium (ROP) Plans: As discussed, these plans are far more expensive. The 'return' you get is usually a very low-return investment. You're better off buying a cheaper pure term plan and investing the difference.
This is where LIC shines. Their legendary trust is built on a high claim settlement ratio. The process is straightforward:

items: The nominee submits the claim form along with the death certificate, original policy documents, and KYC papers.
LIC verifies the claim. As per IRDAI rules, claims must be settled within 30 days of receiving all documents.
If an investigation is needed (usually only for early claims within 3 years of policy start), the timeline can extend to 90-120 days.

Claim Settlement Ratio: LIC consistently reports one of the highest individual death claim settlement ratios in the industry, often exceeding 98%. As of the latest annual report for FY2022-23, their CSR was 98.52%. (Source: LIC Annual Report, Reuters). This is a powerful indicator of their commitment to honoring claims.

sections.title: How to buy an LIC term plan online

items.title: Calculate Your Premium
items.description: Use the online LIC premium calculator to determine the premium for your desired cover amount, age, and policy term.

items.title: Visit LIC's Website
items.description: Go to the official LIC India e-services portal and select the 'New Tech-Term' plan.

items.title: Fill the Application Form
items.description: Provide your personal details, health information, and nominee details accurately in the online form.

items.title: Upload Documents & Pay
items.description: Upload your KYC documents (PAN, Aadhaar) and income proof. Pay the first premium online to complete the process. A medical check-up may be required.

items.q: What is LIC Tech Term Plan and how is it different?
items.a: LIC's New Tech-Term (Plan 954) is a pure-risk, non-linked term insurance plan sold exclusively online. It is different because it is cheaper than its offline counterparts like Jeevan Amar, as it offers a rebate for online sales, cutting out agent commissions. You can find more details on the official LIC product page.

items.q: How much premium for ₹1 Crore LIC term insurance for a 30-year-old non-smoker?
items.a: The premium varies, but for a 30-year-old non-smoker seeking a ₹1 Crore cover until age 60, the yearly premium for a Tech-Term plan is approximately ₹12,000-₹15,000. This translates to roughly ₹1,000-₹1,300 per month. Use our calculator above for a precise quote based on your details.

items.q: Does LIC settle term claims reliably?
items.a: Yes. LIC has one of the highest Claim Settlement Ratios (CSR) in the industry, consistently above 98% (98.52% for FY 2022-23). This, combined with its sovereign guarantee, makes it one of the most reliable insurers for claim settlement in India.

items.q: Can I buy LIC term insurance online?
items.a: Absolutely. LIC offers the 'New Tech-Term' plan specifically for online purchase. The process involves visiting LIC's official website, filling out the proposal form, uploading documents, and paying the premium online.

items.q: Are riders like critical illness covered under LIC term plans?
items.a: Yes, LIC term plans like New Tech-Term and Jeevan Amar offer optional riders, including an Accidental Death and Disability Benefit Rider and a Critical Illness Rider. You should compare the additional cost versus the benefits before adding them to your policy.

items.q: What is the maximum age for LIC term insurance?
items.a: The maximum entry age for most LIC term plans like Tech-Term is 65 years, and the maximum maturity age (the age until which you can be covered) is 80 years.

items.q: Can I get my money back from a term insurance plan?
items.a: In a standard term plan like Tech-Term, no premiums are returned if you survive the policy term. However, LIC's Jeevan Kiran is a 'Return of Premium' (ROP) plan where all premiums paid are returned, but the premiums for these plans are significantly higher.

items.q: Is LIC term insurance cheaper than private companies?
items.a: Generally, LIC's term plans are priced slightly higher than those from top private insurers like HDFC Life or ICICI Prudential. The premium difference is often justified by LIC's higher claim settlement ratio and the unparalleled trust associated with a government-backed entity.

items.q: What documents are needed to buy an LIC term plan?
items.a: You will typically need Proof of Identity (Aadhaar, PAN Card), Proof of Address, and Proof of Income (Salary Slips, ITR). A medical examination may also be required depending on your age and the sum assured.

items.q: What happens if I stop paying my term insurance premium?
items.a: If you stop paying premiums after the grace period, the policy will lapse, and all benefits, including the death benefit, will cease. Unlike endowment plans, pure term plans do not acquire any paid-up or surrender value.

content.text: Case Study 1: Raj, the Early Planner. Raj, a 28-year-old software engineer, bought a ₹1 Crore Tech-Term plan until age 65. His premium was just ₹1,200/month. By buying early, he locked in a low rate for his entire working life, ensuring his family's security for a minimal cost.

Case Study 2: Sunita, the Late Starter. Sunita, a 45-year-old business owner, realized she was underinsured. She opted for a ₹1.5 Crore cover until age 70. Her premium was higher, around ₹4,500/month, but it gave her immense peace of mind knowing her business and family were protected during her peak earning years.

LIC term insurance offers an unparalleled combination of trust and security. While private players might offer slightly lower premiums, the peace of mind that comes with a government-backed policy is invaluable for many. For most users, the LIC Tech-Term plan offers the best balance of low cost and high trust.
